note: A function whose body runs a sloppy direct eval: one call's eval declares a var, another call of the same function did not; each reads or writes the name.

cases.name: read_in_function_after_other_call_declared
cases.js: function f(s) { eval(s); return b; } var b = 1; String([f('var b = 2'), f(''), f('var b = 3'), f('')])

cases.name: read_in_function_before_other_call_declared
cases.js: function f(s) { eval(s); return b; } var b = 1; String([f(''), f('var b = 2'), f('')])

cases.name: closure_made_before_other_call_declared
cases.js: function f(s) { eval(s); return function () { return b; }; } var b = 1; var g1 = f(''); var g2 = f('var b = 2'); String([g1(), g2(), g1()])

cases.name: closure_made_after_other_call_declared
cases.js: function f(s) { eval(s); return function () { return b; }; } var b = 1; var g2 = f('var b = 2'); var g1 = f(''); String([g1(), g2(), g1()])

cases.name: closure_reads_from_a_block
cases.js: function f(s) { eval(s); return function (a) { var d; { let c = 3; d = function () { a; }; with ({}) {} return b; } }; } var b = 1; var g1 = f(''); var g2 = f('var b = 2;'); g1(0); String([g1(0), g2(0)])

cases.name: closure_writes
cases.js: function f(s) { eval(s); return function (v) { b = v; return b; }; } var b = 1; var g2 = f('var b = 2'); var g1 = f(''); String([g1(5), b, g2(7), b, g1(9), b])

cases.name: typeof_a_name_only_another_call_declared
cases.js: function f(s) { eval(s); return function () { return typeof zz; }; } var g2 = f('var zz = 1'); var g1 = f(''); String([g1(), g2()])

cases.name: read_a_name_only_another_call_declared
cases.js: function f(s) { eval(s); return function () { try { return zz; } catch (e) { return e.constructor.name; } }; } var g2 = f('var zz = 1'); var g1 = f(''); String([g1(), g2()])

cases.name: own_eval_after_another_call_declared_other_names
cases.js: function f(s) { eval(s); return function () { return [typeof x, typeof y]; }; } var g1 = f('var x = 1'); var g2 = f('var y = 2'); String([g1(), g2()])

cases.name: delete_an_eval_var
cases.js: function f(s) { eval(s); return function () { return [delete b, typeof b]; }; } var g2 = f('var b = 2'); var g1 = f(''); String([g2(), g1()])

cases.name: later_call_strict_eval_code_reads_a_name_an_earlier_call_declared
cases.js: var f = function (code) { return eval(code); }; String([f("eval('var x = 2;'); typeof x"), f("'use strict'; eval('var x = 2;'); typeof x"), f('typeof x')])

cases.name: later_call_eval_code_reads_a_name_an_earlier_call_declared
cases.js: var f = function (code) { return eval(code); }; String([f('var x = 2; x'), f('typeof x'), f('var x = 3; x'), f('typeof x')])

cases.name: closure_made_before_another_call_declared_reads_by_strict_eval
cases.js: var f = function (c) { if (c) return eval(c); return function (d) { return eval(d); }; }; var old = f(''); f("eval('var x = 2;')"); var r = []; try { r.push(old("'use strict'; typeof x")); } catch (e) { r.push(e.constructor.name); } try { r.push(old('typeof x')); } catch (e) { r.push(e.constructor.name); } String(r)

cases.name: closure_made_before_another_call_declared_declares_it_too
cases.js: var f = function (c) { if (c) return eval(c); return function (d) { return eval(d); }; }; var old = f(''); f("eval('var x = 2;')"); String([old('var x = 5; x'), old('typeof x')])

cases.name: suspended_generator_resumed_after_another_call_declared
cases.js: function* g(c) { yield; return eval(c); } var a = g("'use strict'; typeof x"); a.next(); var b = g("eval('var x = 2'); typeof x"); b.next(); var rb = b.next().value; var r; try { r = a.next().value; } catch (e) { r = e.constructor.name; } String([rb, r])

cases.name: arrow_made_before_another_call_declared
cases.js: var f = function (c) { if (c) return eval(c); return (d) => eval(d); }; var old = f(''); f("eval('var x = 2;')"); var r; try { r = old("'use strict'; typeof x"); } catch (e) { r = e.constructor.name; } String(r)

cases.name: eval_in_eval_made_before_another_call_declared
cases.js: var f = function (c) { if (c) return eval(c); return function (d) { return eval("eval(d)"); }; }; var old = f(''); f("eval('var x = 2;')"); var r; try { r = old("'use strict'; typeof x"); } catch (e) { r = e.constructor.name; } String(r)

cases.name: default_parameters_closure_made_before_another_call_declared
